कौल कौल, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कुल), belonging
or relating to a family, ancestral, extending over a
whole family or race, sprung from a noble family, of
a good family, well-born; (अस्), m. a worshipper of
Śakti according to the left-hand ritual; (अम्), n. the
doctrine and practices of the left-hand Śāktas.
—कौ-
लोपनिषद् (˚ल-उप्˚), त्, f. title of an Upaniṣad.

कौलत्थीन, अस्, आ, अम्, sown with Dolichos
Uniflorus (as a field).

कौलिक, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to a family or
race, customary in a family, ancestral, heritable in
the family; (अस्), m. a weaver; a heretic, an im-
postor; a follower of the left-hand Śākta ritual.

कौलीक कौलीक, अस्, m., Ved. a kind of
bird.

कौलीन, अस्, आ, अम्, peculiar or belonging to a
noble family; (अस्), m. the son of a female beggar;
a follower of the left-hand Śākta ritual; (अम्), n.
rumour, report; evil report, detraction; family scan-
dal; combat of animals, of birds, snakes, &c.; cock-
fighting, &c.; contention of animals as a species of
gambling; a privity, a privy part, the pudenda; high
birth, family descent; an improper act, a bad deed.

कौलीन्य, अम्, n. high birth, nobility; family
honour; family trouble, family scandal.

कौल्य, अस्, आ, अम्, sprung from a noble family,
of good family or parentage; of the left-hand
Śākta sect.
कौल्य; add — (अम्), n. noble origin, good family.

कौलटिनेय कौलटिनेय, अस्, ई, m. f. (fr.
कुलटा), the son or daughter of a female beggar; a
bastard.

कौलटेय, अस्, ई, m. f. the child of a female beggar;
a bastard, the child of a disloyal wife.

कौलटेर, अस्, आ, m. f. a bastard, son or daughter
of a disloyal wife; the child of a beggar.

कौलव कौलव, अस्, m., N. of the third
Karaṇa or astronomical period.

कौलाल कौलाल, अस्, m., Ved. a potter, =
कुलाल; the son of a potter.
—कौलाल-चक्र, अम्,
n. a potter's wheel.

कौलालक, अस्, ई, अम्, made by a potter, pertaining
to a potter; (अम्), n. earthenware, porcelain.

कौलितर कौलितर, अस्, m., Ved. an epithet
of the demon Śambara.

कौलिशिक कौलिशिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कुलिश),
resembling a thunderbolt.

कौलीरा कौलीरा, f. (fr. कुलीर), N. of a
plant, = कर्कट-शृङ्गी.

कौलूत कौलूत, अस्, m. a king of the Ku-
lūtas; (a various reading has कौलूभ.)

कौल्मलबर्हिष कौल्मलबर्हिष, अम्, n.,
N. of a Sāman called after Kulmala-barhiṣa.

कौल्माषी कौल्माषी, f. (fr. कुल्माष), a
day of full moon on which Kulmāṣa is eaten.

कौल्माषीण, अस्, आ, अम्, sown with or fit for
Kulmāṣa (as a field).
